description: Compares US telehealth providers of GLP-1 weight-loss medication by price, plan, rating and state. Returns each provider’s cheapest matching plan (monthly price, total due today, coupon and renewal price), its rating, and links.getStarted, the provider’s sign-up URL. Optional filters select a compounding pharmacy, an additive (none or a named additive), feature keys such as FSA/HSA or pick your pharmacy, and a minimum rating. Covers semaglutide, tirzepatide, Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro and Zepbound.

additive.description: Formula filter. "none" is additive-free. Other values are additives: b12, b6, b3, glycine, l_carnitine, nad. Limits results to providers with a pharmacy in the person’s state that lists that formula.

currently_taking_glp1.description: Whether the person already takes a GLP-1. Starter packs are for new patients. When this is omitted, a starter plan can appear among the results.

dosage_mg.description: Weekly dose in mg to price, for example 2.5 for tirzepatide or 0.25 for semaglutide. When omitted, the cheapest starting dose is used.

drug.description: The compounded molecule (semaglutide, tirzepatide), a brand name (ozempic, wegovy, mounjaro, zepbound), or "any". A brand name also returns the compounded alternatives of the same molecule.

features.description: Feature keys that every result has, for example "FSA_HSA", "PICK_PHARMACY", "ADDITIVE_SELECTION", "VIDEO_CALLS", "LABS_INCLUDED" or "24_7_SUPPORT". An unknown key is returned with the list of known keys.

include_brand_name.description: Whether results include telehealth providers that prescribe brand-name Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro or Zepbound. When omitted, naming a brand includes those providers.

limit.description: How many providers to return, from 1 to 10.

max_monthly_price.description: Monthly price cap in dollars. Providers whose cheapest matching plan costs more than this are excluded.

min_rating.description: Minimum composite review rating, from 1 to 5. Providers below this rating are excluded.

pharmacy.description: Compounding pharmacy name or slug. Limits results to providers that fill prescriptions through that pharmacy in the person’s state.

plan_type.description: The kind of plan to include: month-to-month ("monthly"), a prepaid 3, 6 or 12-month plan, a starter pack, a step-up plan, a microdose plan, or "any".

sort.description: "best" orders by GLP Winner’s composite score, then price. "cheapest" orders by monthly price.

state.description: The person’s US state, as a two-letter code ("TX") or a full name ("Texas"). Which providers are available, and some prices, depend on the state.

name: search_glp1_providers
title: Search GLP-1 providers
